name: LRS (Lakeshore Recycling Systems)
notes: Moved from the catalog default utility-account family to the trash-specific waste-hauler family. Researched from the public lrsrecycles.com home page and Billing and Payments page (client-rendered, read in a browser) and the public LRS Customer Portal registration page (my.lrsrecyclesdigital.com, linked from the LRS home page as Create an account, so lrsrecyclesdigital.com is in officialDomains); never signed in or submitted a form. Pay My Bill asks whether the bill is for individual (one-off) or recurring services and the ZIP code, because different states use different payment processors; the processor pages were not opened (guest lookup modelled as account number + ZIP, inferred). Paperless billing is requested with a form on the billing page (paperless supported, documented; the mock models it as a toggle). ACH: send remittance details to AR@LRSrecycles.com (bank details published; not modelled). Checks: LRS, PO Box 4700, Carol Stream, IL 60197. Billing questions 844-NEED-LRS (844-633-3577). The new Customer Portal offers Continue with Google or e-mail with a password of at least 8 characters including upper and lower case, a number and a special character (!@#$%^&*), then address verification; it is currently open only to municipal customers in Indianapolis, Evanston, Burbank (IL), Lake Villa Township and Monticello (MN). AutoPay is not described publicly, so autopay is unknown with a contact note. No convenience or late fee is published.

passwordRule.message: Password must be at least 8 characters long and contain one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one special character (!@#$%^&*).

guest_pay.note: Choose whether you are paying for recurring service or a one-time service, and enter your ZIP code so your payment goes to the right processor.

registration.note: The LRS Customer Portal is currently open to municipal customers in Indianapolis, IN; Evanston, IL; Burbank, IL; Lake Villa Township, IL; and Monticello, MN.

autopay.note: Automatic payment options depend on your community. Call LRS at 844-NEED-LRS (844-633-3577) to ask about AutoPay.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call LRS at 844-NEED-LRS (844-633-3577) about your bill.

help.title: Paying your LRS bill
paragraphs: Start at Pay My Bill and say what you are paying for: recurring services (ongoing contracted pickup with a regular bill, such as weekly waste and recycling) or individual services (standalone rentals or one-time services). Then enter your ZIP code: different states in the LRS network use slightly different payment processors, and the ZIP code routes your payment correctly.

To pay by check, mail it to LRS, PO Box 4700, Carol Stream, IL 60197 with your customer number, invoice numbers (with their two-letter prefix) and amounts. For ACH, e-mail the same remittance details to the Accounts Receivable team at AR@LRSrecycles.com.
Questions about your bill: call 844-NEED-LRS (844-633-3577) or use the Contact Us form with your service address, phone number and question.

help.title: Going paperless
paragraphs: To receive your LRS bills electronically, fill out the Sign Up for Paperless form at the top of the Billing and Payments page.

help.title: The LRS Customer Portal
paragraphs: Create your login with Continue with Google, or with an e-mail address and a password of at least 8 characters that includes an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character (!@#$%^&*). You then verify your service address.
The portal is being rolled out: right now it is open to municipal LRS customers in Indianapolis, IN; Evanston, IL; Burbank, IL; Lake Villa Township, IL; and Monticello, MN.

extra.intent: Using LRS's billing help, find out why LRS asks for your ZIP code before you pay your bill. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
